name: Wrike
label: Wrike API v4
description: Wrike API v4 via OfficialApiNode. Base https://{datacenter}/api/v4 (www.wrike.com, app-eu.wrike.com, app-us2.wrike.com — https://developers.wrike.com/docs/faq). Bearer access_token. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Wrike official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"folder_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'folder_create', 'folder_delete', 'task_create', 'task_get', 'task_find', 'task_list_in_folder', 'task_delete', 'task_update', 'timelog_create', 'listen'. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: 'folder_create'.

schema.label: folderId
schema.description: Wrike folder id. Path for folder_create, folder_delete, task_create, task_list_in_folder. Example: IEAAAAA.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Folder or task title. Required on folder_create / task_create; used on task_update / task_find. Example: Launch plan.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Task status. EXACT: Active | Completed | Deferred | Cancelled. task_create / task_update / task_find. Example: Active.

schema.label: taskId
schema.description: Wrike task id. Path for task_get / task_update / task_delete / timelog_create. Example: IEAAAAAT.

schema.label: responsibles
schema.description: Comma-separated contact ids. task_find filter. Example: KUAAAA,KUAAAB.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: folder_create, folder_delete, task_create, task_get, task_find, task_list_in_folder, task_delete, task_update, timelog_create, listen. Default: folder_create. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event. Example: folder_create.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Datacenter host
configurationParameters.description: Wrike API host without scheme. Default www.wrike.com. EU: app-eu.wrike.com. US2: app-us2.wrike.com. Use the host from OAuth token exchange. https://developers.wrike.com/docs/oauth-20-authorization

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
